mapper.update: /*setBntTrxlUploadReg*/ INSERT INTO BNTTRXL ( DOC_NAME , TARGET , KEY_1 , KEY_2 , KEY_3 , KEY_4 , KEY_5 , KEY_6 , KEY_7 , KEY_8 , KEY_9 , KEY_10 , KEY_11 , KEY_12 , KEY_13 , KEY_14 , KEY_15 , KEY_16 , KEY_17 , KEY_18 , KEY_19 , KEY_20 , KEY_21 , KEY_22 , KEY_23 , KEY_24 ) VALUES( 'CTLG_MD', --DOC_NAME #{st_user_id}, -- TARGET USER_ID #{BUYER}, -- KEY_1 BYCA_COMORG_CODE #{BUYER_ITEM_NO}, -- KEY_2 BUYER_ITEM_NO #{SEQ}, -- KEY_3 SEQ ' ',-- KEY_4 ' ',-- KEY_5 ' ',-- KEY_6 ' ',-- KEY_7 ' ',-- KEY_8 ' ',-- KEY_9 ' ',-- KEY_10 NVL(#{MAKER_CODE},'★'), -- KEY_11 MAKER_CODE NVL((SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M104' AND CODE = #{MAKER_CODE} AND FLAG = 'Y'),'★'), -- KEY_12 MAKER_NAME NVL(#{ORIGIN_CODE},'★'), -- KEY_13 ORIGIN_CODE NVL(#{MAKER_PART_NO},'★'), --KEY_14 MAKER_PART_NO ' ',-- KEY_15 ' ',-- KEY_16 ' ',-- KEY_17 ' ',-- KEY_18 ' ',-- KEY_19 ' ',-- KEY_20 ' ',-- KEY_21 NVL(#{DESCRIPTION},'★'), -- KEY_22 DESCRIPTION NVL(#{SPECIFICATION},'★'), -- KEY_23 SPECIFICATION NVL(#{CH_CMS_CATEG_ID},'★') -- KEY_24 CH_CMS_CATEG_ID )
mapper.select:
/*getMasterMdCmCaInfoBeforeAfter*/ SELECT A.DOC_NAME , A.USER_ID , A.BUYER , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , A.STATUS_CODE , (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'M161' AND CODE = A.STATUS_CODE) AS STATUS_CODE_TEXT , A.CHECK_TEXT , A.BELOW_COMORG_TEXT , A.AGENT_TEXT , A.CONTRACT_NO , A.CONTRACT_SEQ , A.MAKER_CODE , A.MAKER_NAME , A.ORIGIN_CODE , A.MAKER_PART_NO , A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE , A.AGENT , A.DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.CH_CMS_CATEG_ID , A.CH_CMS_CATEG_NAME , A.CMS_CATLG_ID , A.GBN , A.SEQ FROM ( SELECT DOC_NAME ,TARGET AS USER_ID , KEY_1 AS BUYER , KEY_2 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , DECODE((SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'D1','C') FLAG FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = TRXL.KEY_1 AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = TRXL.KEY_2 AND STATUS <> 'D'), 'C', DECODE( ( SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'D2','C') AS FLAG FROM ( SELECT BUYER FLAG FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND BUYER IN (SELECT BELOW_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = TRXL.KEY_1 AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = TRXL.KEY_2) AND KEP_USER_ID = TRXL.TARGET AND STATUS <> 'O'
UNION ALL
SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = TRXL.TARGET AND DEPARTMENT IN (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SOURDEPT') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EXCCMPY' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE IN (SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE BYCA_COMORG_CODE = TRXL.KEY_1) ) ) ) , 'C', (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 1, 'C', 'D3') FROM BNTTRXL TRXL2 WHERE TRXL2.DOC_NAME = TRXL.DOC_NAME AND TRXL2.TARGET = TRXL.TARGET AND TRXL2.KEY_1 = TRXL.KEY_1 AND TRXL2.KEY_2 = TRXL.KEY_2), 'D2' ), 'D1') AS STATUS_CODE , '변경후' AS CHECK_TEXT , KEY_5 AS BELOW_COMORG_TEXT , KEY_6 AS AGENT_TEXT , KEY_7 AS CONTRACT_NO , KEY_8 AS CONTRACT_SEQ , DECODE(KEY_11,'★','',KEY_11) AS MAKER_CODE , DECODE(KEY_12,'★','',KEY_12) AS MAKER_NAME , DECODE(KEY_13,'★','',KEY_13) AS ORIGIN_CODE , DECODE(KEY_14,'★','',KEY_14) AS MAKER_PART_NO , KEY_15 AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE , KEY_16 AS AGENT , DECODE(KEY_22,'★','',KEY_22) AS DESCRIPTION , DECODE(KEY_23,'★','',KEY_23) AS SPECIFICATION , DECODE(KEY_24,'★','',KEY_24) AS CH_CMS_CATEG_ID , (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG CMS WHERE CMS.CMS_CATEG_ID = KEY_24) AS CH_CMS_CATEG_NAME , '' AS CMS_CATLG_ID , '0' AS GBN , KEY_3 AS SEQ FROM BNTTRXL TRXL WHERE TRXL.DOC_NAME = 'CTLG_MD' AND TRXL.TARGET = #{st_user_id} UNION ALL SELECT '' AS DOC_NAME ,'' AS USER_ID , CQDT.BUYER AS BUYER , CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , DECODE((SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'D1','C') FLAG FROM ICOMBYIT WHERE BUYER = TRXL.KEY_1 AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = TRXL.KEY_2 AND STATUS <> 'D'), 'C', DECODE( ( SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*),0,'D2','C') AS FLAG FROM ( SELECT BUYER FLAG FROM MIS_BUYER_MNG WHERE YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AND BUYER IN (SELECT BELOW_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMCQDT WHERE BUYER = TRXL.KEY_1 AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = TRXL.KEY_2) AND KEP_USER_ID = TRXL.TARGET AND STATUS <> 'O'
UNION ALL
SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = TRXL.TARGET AND DEPARTMENT IN (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'SOURDEPT') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'x' FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EXCCMPY' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND CODE IN (SELECT COM_CODE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE BYCA_COMORG_CODE = TRXL.KEY_1) ) ) ) , 'C', (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 1, 'C', 'D3') FROM BNTTRXL TRXL2 WHERE TRXL2.DOC_NAME = TRXL.DOC_NAME AND TRXL2.TARGET = TRXL.TARGET AND TRXL2.KEY_1 = TRXL.KEY_1 AND TRXL2.KEY_2 = TRXL.KEY_2), 'D2' ), 'D1') AS STATUS_CODE , '변경전' AS CHECK_TEXT , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQDT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AS BELOW_COMORG_TEXT , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CQDT.AGENT) AS AGENT_TEXT , CQDT.CONTRACT_NO AS CONTRACT_NO , CQDT.CONTRACT_SEQ AS CONTRACT_SEQ , CQDT.MAKER_CODE AS MAKER_CODE , CQDT.MAKER_NAME AS MAKER_NAME , CQDT.ORIGIN_CODE AS ORIGIN_CODE , BYIT.MAKER_PART_NO AS MAKER_PART_NO , CQDT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE AS BELOW_COMORG_CODE , CQDT.AGENT AS AGENT , BYIT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION , BYIT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION , BYIT.CMS_CATEG_ID AS CH_CMS_CATEG_ID , (SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM CMSCATEG CMS WHERE CMS.CMS_CATEG_ID = BYIT.CMS_CATEG_ID ) AS CH_CMS_CATEG_NAME , BYIT.CMS_CATLG_ID AS CMS_CATLG_ID , '1' AS GBN , TO_CHAR(ROWNUM) AS SEQ FROM ICOMCQDT CQDT, ICOMBYIT BYIT, BNTTRXL TRXL WHERE CQDT.BUYER = TRXL.KEY_1 AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = TRXL.KEY_2 AND CQDT.BUYER = BYIT.BUYER AND CQDT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = BYIT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND TRXL.DOC_NAME = 'CTLG_MD' AND TRXL.TARGET = #{st_user_id} AND CQDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND BYIT.STATUS <> 'D' ) A WHERE 1=1
AND A.STATUS_CODE = #{st_status_text}
ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.GBN, A.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, A.AGENT
